title: LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning via a Latent-Space Unified Model
abstract: arXiv:2604.02097v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified models (UMs) hold promise for their ability to understand and generate content across heterogeneous modalities. Compared to merely generating visual content, the use of UMs for interleaved cross-modal reasoning is more promising and valuable, e.g., for solving understanding problems that require dense visual thinking, improving visual generation through self-reflection, or modeling visual dynamics of the physical world guided by stepwise action interventions. However, existing UMs typically rely on pixel decoding as a bridge when their visual representations for understanding and generation are disjoint, which is both ineffective and computationally cumbersome. In this paper, we introduce LatentUM, a novel unified model that represents all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating pixel-space mediation for model-internal reasoning over generated visual states. By making generated visual tokens direct

translated_title: LatentUM：通过潜在空间统一模型释放交错跨模态推理的潜力
translated_abstract: 统一模型因其能够理解和生成异构模态内容而备受期待。与仅仅生成视觉内容相比，将统一模型用于交错的跨模态推理更具前景和价值，例如解决需要密集视觉思考的理解问题、通过自我反思改进视觉生成，或在逐步动作干预引导下建模物理世界的视觉动态。然而，现有的统一模型在理解和生成的视觉表征相互割裂时，通常依赖像素解码作为桥梁，这既低效又计算繁琐。本文提出了LatentUM，一种新颖的统一模型，它在共享的语义潜在空间中表示所有模态，从而消除了对生成的视觉状态进行模型内部推理时的像素空间中介，并使生成的视觉token能够直接参与推理。
tldr: 本文提出LatentUM统一模型，通过在共享语义潜在空间中表示所有模态，消除了像素空间解码中介，实现了高效的交错跨模态推理。
en_tdlr: LatentUM is a novel unified model that represents all modalities in a shared semantic latent space, eliminating pixel-space mediation to enable efficient interleaved cross-modal reasoning.
